note: The exact host surface these plugins depend on. scripts/check-contracts.mjs keeps the plugin source aligned with these names and, when given an extracted app.asar directory, confirms the host still exposes them. This is a smoke check for renames/removals, not a behavioral guarantee.

slots.name: settings.section.icon
slots.matchBy: same id as the settings.section entry

slots.name: conversation.chat.turnTail
slots.ownerContract: turn is the RICH Timeline Turn object {turn:<number>, start, end, status, steps, data} from node.location.turn (Location resolve returns {kind:'turn', turn: timeline.turns.get(n)}); read the number as turn.turn, end event seq as turn.end.seq, and per-turn facts via turn.data.get(key). The separate `seq` prop is the final assistant node seq, NOT the turn/end event seq. Per-turn facts for a scope:'turn' buildLocationData live on turn.data; chat nodes.turnDataSource only indexes definitions that also emit a target:'chat' view node.

chatTimeline.turnById: timeline.turns.get(n): { turn, start, end, status, data:Map, steps }
chatTimeline.turnEndSeq: turn.end.seq is the turn/end event seq
